name: autologin
effect: turns the display manager's automatic login for the operator user on or off (SDDM, GDM or LightDM; any other display manager is refused); enable names the desktop session to start (an installed X11 or Wayland session; GDM starts the user's own default); takes effect at the next boot or display manager restart; the login keyring is not unlocked by an automatic login and its state is reported
